errors.text_span: 图表采用了母子饼图（复合饼图）的形式，总共显示了四个切片
errors.evidence: The figure contains a total of four slices but they are distributed between two pie charts, not one compound pie chart.
The description does not clearly state the purpose or meaning of the pie charts relating to 'an' structure as indicated by the title.
The description mentions a legend but does not note its absence in explaining the connection between colors and numbers.
